fullDesc: On June 19, 1865 Union General Gordon Granger announced in Galveston, Texas that all enslaved people were free. It came two and a half years after the Emancipation Proclamation, and the date is now celebrated as Juneteenth.
realFacts: Juneteenth became a US federal holiday in 2021
Celebrations began in Texas the next year
The name joins June and nineteenth
It is also called Emancipation Day
